{{recipe}} | [[Cookbook:Vegetarian cuisine|Vegetarian cuisine]]

== Ingredients ==
* 4 large [[Cookbook:Portobello Mushroom|Portobello mushrooms]]
* [[Cookbook:Balsamic vinegar|Balsamic vinegar]]
* [[Cookbook:Garlic|Garlic]], [[Cookbook:Mince|minced]]
* 1 [[Cookbook:Egg|egg]]
* ½ [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] [[Cookbook:Cottage Cheese|cottage cheese]]
* 4 [[Cookbook:Ounce|oz]] [[Cookbook:Mozzarella Cheese|mozzarella cheese]] (fresh or regular), [[Cookbook:Dice|diced]] or [[Cookbook:Grating|grated]]
* 10 Saltine crackers, crushed or ½ cup [[Cookbook:Bread Crumb|bread crumbs]]
* [[Cookbook:Salt|Salt]]
* [[Cookbook:Pepper|Pepper]]
* Other seasonings to taste

== Procedure ==
#Generously sprinkle vinegar over the mushrooms, and top with garlic. Leave for 30 minutes or so.
#Combine the egg, cheeses, crackers and seasonings in a bowl. Mix well. Spoon the mixture onto the mushrooms.
#[[Cookbook:Baking|Bake]] at 350°F for 40 minutes.
